full_prompt_en: A square surreal fine-art portrait shows a woman in a deep red garment in profile beneath a cloud of pale paper birds. The background is an even charcoal-gray studio field, nearly featureless and darkest toward the right, leaving a wide area of quiet space on the left. The woman stands near the lower center and faces left, her head and upper torso seen from the side. Her fair face is softly modeled, with a small red mouth, calm eye, and sharply defined nose against the gray ground. Auburn hair is gathered into a low textured bun. The high-necked red garment has a tied detail beneath the chin and softly tailored shoulders; its rich color is the only broad saturated area in the picture. From the crown and hair, many small angular pale shapes rise and spread toward the upper right, resembling folded birds in flight. Some are crisp white triangles, while others are muted gray and half lost in the darker field. They overlap densely just above the head and gradually disperse into separate flecks toward the top and left, creating an airy counterweight to the still figure. There is no visible setting, furniture, or horizon, so the transformation between hair and flying shapes becomes the central event. The skin and cloth appear smooth and photographic, while the paperlike pieces have hard folded edges and irregular tonal surfaces. Soft directional light reaches the face from the upper left, catching cheekbone, nose, and the brighter folded forms, while the far side of the bun and collar recedes into shadow. The overall composition is restrained and dreamlike, balancing a concentrated red vertical silhouette against a light, dissolving diagonal swarm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实艺术肖像呈现一位身穿深红衣服的女子侧立，头顶浮着一片浅色纸鸟。背景是均匀的炭灰色影棚色域，几乎没有特征，向右侧更暗，左边留下宽阔宁静的空间。女子站在画面下部中央附近，面朝左方，侧面可见头部和上半身。浅肤色面孔经过柔和塑形，一点红唇、平静的眼睛与清楚的鼻梁在灰底前显露。赤褐色头发向后挽成低位、有肌理的发髻。高领红衣在下巴下方系结，肩部剪裁柔和；丰厚红色是画里唯一宽阔的饱和区域。从头顶与头发中，许多小而有角的浅色形状向上、向右展开，像飞起的折纸鸟。有些是清脆白色三角形，另一些呈低调灰色，半融入深色场域。它们在头顶刚上方密集叠合，向上缘和左方逐渐散成独立碎片，为静止人物提供轻盈的平衡。没有可见的场所、家具或地平线，因此头发与飞翔形状之间的变换成为核心事件。皮肤和布料平滑、富摄影感，纸样碎片则有坚硬折边和明暗不齐的表面。柔和定向光从左上方照到面部，掠亮颧骨、鼻梁与更亮的折叠形状，发髻远侧和衣领退入阴影。整体构图克制而梦幻，以集中的红色竖向剪影平衡一团轻盈消散的斜向飞群。
style_prompt_en: The surreal photographic treatment combines smooth, restrained tonal modeling with one concentrated saturated color and a scattering of pale, sharply edged fragments. Large charcoal negative space isolates the focal mass, allowing tiny pieces to register clearly as they move from dense overlap to wide dispersion. Surface contrast is important: skinlike gradients and soft cloth folds sit against crisp folded edges and irregular matte facets. The palette stays near monochrome in the surroundings, while deep crimson provides a single emphatic warm anchor. Directional studio light grazes the brightest planes and leaves the opposite side in delicate shadow, avoiding a hard spotlight. A stable vertical form is countered by an ascending diagonal rhythm that becomes progressively lighter and more open. The overall effect is quiet and uncanny, with a believable photographic base supporting a restrained impossible transformation.
style_prompt_zh: 这种超现实摄影处理把平滑克制的明度塑形、一处集中的饱和颜色和散落的浅色锐边碎片结合起来。大片炭灰留白隔离焦点体块，让小碎片从密集重叠走向宽散时仍能清楚辨认。表面反差很关键：肌肤般渐层与柔软布褶对照清脆折边和不规则哑光切面。周围色板接近单色，深绯红提供唯一强烈暖色锚点。定向影棚光掠过最亮平面，在反侧留下细柔阴影，避免坚硬聚光。稳定的竖向形体由上升的斜向节奏对抗，后者逐渐变轻、变开阔。整体效果安静而奇异，以可信的摄影基底支撑克制的不可能变换。
theme_en: A red-dressed woman in profile beneath a cloud of pale paper birds
theme_zh: 身穿红衣的侧面女子，头顶浮起一片浅色纸鸟
name: Daria Petrilli
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
